name: Doosan DVF 5000
description: 5-axis vertical machining centre with a FANUC 31i-B5 Plus: X/Y/Z spindle side and a B (tilt, about Y) / C (rotary) table.
sources: FANUC Series 30i/31i/32i-MODEL B Plus operator's manuals B-64724EN, B-64724EN-2 and parameter manual B-64730EN (DoosanFanuc3xDoc)
DVF 5000 programs in DoosanDVF5000Memory (post DOOSANDVF5000_5X_TC_TB_RTCP): table B and C, G68.2 + G53.1 3+2 positioning, G43.4 TCP, machine park position G53 X-350. Y225.
Doosan DVF 5000 published specification: X 625 mm, Y 450 mm, Z 400 mm travels
axisNote: Travels, rapid rates and the B range are placeholders around the published 625/450/400 mm strokes: the programs place the machine origin between the X/Y ends (G53 X-350. Y225. is the park position) and use B-25.312 to B90. Replace them with the machine's parameters 1320/1321 (stroke limits), 1420 (rapid rates) and 19741-19744 (rotary ranges).

mrzp.label: Rotary centre (parameters 19700-19714)
mrzp.source: Placeholder: the machine coordinate origin is assumed to lie on the B and C axes. Replace with the table rotation centre of FANUC parameters 19700-19714.

rotaryConvention.note: B turns the table about +Y and carries C, which turns it about +Z; both follow the ISO primed-axis convention (sense -1 on both nodes).
rotaryConvention.evidence: Every G68.2 plane in the DVF programs matches the B/C the post outputs with it (for example I156. J25.312 K-153.779 with B-25.312 C246. and with B25.312 C66.), which holds only for B about Y carrying C with sense -1.

referencePositions.note: Placeholders for parameters 1240 (G28) and 1241 (G30): G91 G28 Z0 returns Z to the top of its stroke.

toolChanger.note: The post retracts with G91 G28 Z0 before M06; the preview also lifts Z to the reference position if it is lower.

workOffsets.note: Work offsets that the program or the initial macro variables do not define (#5221-#5340, #7001+, #14001+) are placed at the rotary centre with B0 C0.

parameterNotes.1401#1: LRP = 1 (linear rapids): required for tilted working plane indexing, which the programs use.
parameterNotes.3401#0: DPI = 0: values without a decimal point are least input increments (0.001 mm).
parameterNotes.3404#7: M3B = 1: up to three M codes per block (the programs send M11 M39 together).
parameterNotes.5148: Fine boring / back boring shift direction (placeholder).
parameterNotes.11221#0: MTW = 1: G68.4 incremental tilted working plane (O999/O1999 use it).
parameterNotes.13451#1: ATW = 1: G68.2 I0 J0 K0 is accepted (the programs use it for flat operations).
parameterNotes.19696#5: WKP = 0: tool center point control is programmed in the table coordinate system.

mCodes.name: Rotary axis clamp
mCodes.notes: The DVF programs send M10 M38 as CLAMP BC.

mCodes.name: Rotary axis unclamp
mCodes.notes: The DVF programs send M11 M39 as UNCLAMP BC before simultaneous 5-axis moves.

mCodes.name: Rotary axis clamp
mCodes.notes: Sent with M10 as CLAMP BC.

mCodes.name: Rotary axis unclamp
mCodes.notes: Sent with M11 as UNCLAMP BC.

kinematics.description: X/Y/Z move the spindle relative to the table (drawn on the spindle side); B tilts the table about a line parallel to Y through the rotary centre and carries the C table.
